department: Hermann Staudinger Graduate School (Chemistry and Pharmacy)

deadline.value: The school asks applicants to apply at the earliest possible date and to have foreign-degree papers in the PhD office four weeks before a committee meeting; no dates are given.
deadline.quote: must be available in the PhD office at least four weeks before the next meeting of the Doctoral Examination Committee

gre_subject.value: No GRE Subject Test exists for this field: ETS discontinued the GRE Chemistry Test in May 2023.
gre_subject.quote: The GRE Chemistry Test was discontinued in May 2023.

supervisor.value: A doctoral supervision agreement with the faculty is an attachment that must be uploaded with the acceptance application.
supervisor.quote: Doctoral supervision agreement of the Faculty of Chemistry and Pharmacy (§ 4 (2) of PO 2016)

also.quote: The following attachments (according to § 6 (2) of PO 2016) must be kept ready (each as a PDF file) for the application in HISinOne

funding.value: The acceptance page states no funding or stipend rule.

entry_route.value: The page asks for proof of a degree qualifying for doctoral studies, with a Master of Science certificate as the example, but does not say a Master's is required.

notes: Acceptance is by the faculty doctoral committee via HISinOne with a printed signed form to the PhD Office. Foreign degrees must be recognised by the committee (PO 2016 § 5 (2)). The school page names no fee, English test or funding rule, so the graduate-school values apply. Structured school, not a separate admissions track.
